questions.question: On pass mark boundary, what do the HNGV notices say and what does the statute say?
questions.reference_note: Notices: score equal to or above 60 is suitable / written test "valor 60" continues. Statute: Decree-Law 34/2008 Art. 35(1): 60 points or less in an eliminatory phase = disqualified.

questions.question: On minimum age, what do the HNGV notices say and what does the statute say?
questions.reference_note: Notices: 20 to 55 years (special career regime). Statute: Law 5/2009 (amending Law 8/2004) Art. 14(b): 17 to 55 years.

questions.question: On official language, what do the HNGV notices say and what does the statute say?
questions.reference_note: Notices: mastery of Tetum and Portuguese (CPI/4: Tetum + minimum Portuguese and English). Statute: Decree-Law 34/2008 Art. 23: fluency in at least one official language.
